artworks.title: The Birth of Athena
artworks.description: Rude's relief on the east pediment of the Madeleine in Paris dramatises the moment Metis' swallowed counsel becomes visible power: Zeus's head is cleft and Athena springs forth armed. The Oceanid herself never appears on the surface of the stone — she has already been absorbed into the king — yet the scene is her myth's climax.
